name: Child of Nature
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Greetings, young friend. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade.

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you.

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText: A high elf, speaking to me... in Thunder Bluff. Will wonders never cease?Well, shaper of wind, let me join our Earthen Ring brothers and sisters in welcoming you to Azeroth. My fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.
